shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx'; do printf '\\nFILE: %s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next -maxdepth 3 -type d -iname '*doc*' | head -50; rg -n 'cacheComponents|use cache|connection\\(' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/products.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git status --short && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""
/bin/bash -lc 'node --version && npm view next version && npm view next@latest engines --json'

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && rg -n 'cacheComponents' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20 && git diff -- package.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
const urls = [
  '/products/lamp',
  '/products/lamp?currency=EUR',
  '/products/vase?currency=EUR',
  '/products/vase?currency=USD',
  '/products/unknown?currency=EUR',
]
for (const path of urls) {
  const response = await fetch("'`http://localhost:3100${path}`)
  const html = await response.text()
  const checks = {
    lamp: html.includes('"'Brass lamp'),
    vase: html.includes('Stone vase'),
    usd120: html.includes('USD 120.00'),
    eur110: html.includes('EUR 110.40'),
    usd80: html.includes('USD 80.00'),
    eur73: html.includes('EUR 73.60'),
    related: html.includes('Related products'),
    noindex: html.includes('noindex'),
  }
  console.log(path, response.status, JSON.stringify(checks))
}
EOF"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts lib/products.ts 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' package.json tsconfig.json && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache|dynamicParams)|connection\\(' app lib next.config.ts || true && cat package.json && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next-env.d.ts && cat .gitignore && git show HEAD:package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json .gitignore next-env.d.ts && rg -n 'use cache|cacheLife|cacheComponents|partialPrefetching|Suspense|ProductDetails|RelatedProducts' next.config.ts lib/products.ts 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx'"
